examples.arabic: الأم ابتسمت وقالت: كرتكم عند الشجرة الكبيرة.
examples.english: The mother smiled and said: Your ball is near the big tree.
examples.transliteration: Al-ummu ibtasamat wa qalat: Kuratukum 'inda ash-shajarah al-kabeerah.
examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.english: The mother wants a very big party.

examples.arabic: ركضت الام مسرعة لتبعد طفلها وتعتذر عن فضوله الكبير
examples.english: The mother ran quickly to pull her child away and apologize for his great curiosity
examples.transliteration: rakadat al umm musria li tubid tiflaha wa taatazhir an fudulih al kabir

examples.arabic: تعيش أمينة في منزل متنوع مع عائلتها المضيفة الأم المسيحية ماري والابن الملحد جون.
examples.english: Amina lives in a diverse house with her host family, the Christian mother Mary and the atheist son John.
examples.transliteration: Taeish amina fi manzil mutanawwi maa ailatiha almudifa alum almasihiya mari walibn almulhid jun.

examples.arabic: تسال الام ابنتها هل قضيت وقتا جميلا مع عائلتك
examples.english: The mother asks her daughter have you spent a nice time with your family.
examples.transliteration: Tasalu al umm ibnataha hal qadayti waqtan jamilan maa aailatiki

examples.arabic: الام تجيب بصبر وهو يسأل عن المدرسين
examples.english: The mother answers patiently and he asks about the teachers.
examples.transliteration: Al-umm tujeeb bisabr wa huwa yasal an al-mudarriseen
